entities.summary: "Lake of Fire" is a song by the American alternative rock band the Meat Puppets, written by vocalist and guitarist Curt Kirkwood. It appears on their second album, Meat Puppets II, released in April 1984. An alternate version appeared as a hidden track on their 1994 album, Too High to Die.
